notes.title: Localization Workshop
notes.content:
Our Hand is Empty, followers ✋🏻

Without delay, we want to end this year with an important game update and get better right now.

Fixes:
- Text skipping now correctly completes the door scene animation.
- Candlelight no longer obscures glossary window text.
- Some words are italicized, as in the original text.
- The sounds have been cleared of noise, and the flies now only sound where they fly.
- Other minor code optimizations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41411524/85513334b7a928b2b9f1b1ab0a23971f336e2d21.png

Steam Workshop Support
We created a special mod loader, which will give initiative admirers of Dostoevsky the ability to upload their translations, giving the whole community the opportunity to play the game in any language of the world (even no longer existing, for example, in the original pre-revolutionary (imperial) Russian, which is already available for download). This innovation was created thanks to amazing people who offer their help with localization. Your native language isn't on the list of supported languages and you'd like to fix it? We're looking forward to your work, and we're sure players from all over the world will be grateful for your efforts.

Steam Cloud Support
Now your game saves will always be with you thanks to cloud storage. 
Now these are real saves from St. Petersburg.

Expanding the Glossary
The vocabulary of the glossary was considerably extended. If some words still cause you questions - let us know in the forum.

Play with Bottles
Bottles now make different sounds when you point them. 
Can you play a nocturne on them?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41411524/1af0850d68c689175a820d7f60effb0953b76239.png

Feel free to let us know what you think about the update on Twitter and don't forget to get the game for yourself or your friends at a discount until January 5!

See you at the next meeting.
Happy New Winter!
